[{"gloss": "(inhaled thing:) breath, air, vapors", "gsr": "0517a", "middle_chinese": "khj+jH", "old_chinese": "*C.qʰəp-s"}, {"fanqie": "去既", "middle_chinese_guangyun": "溪開三C微去", "source": "guangyun"}, {"old_chinese_zhengzhang": "kʰɯds", "rhyme_group": "隊", "source": "zhengzhang"}]
A person 亻 breathing air 米
Phonosemantic compound. 米 represents the meaning and 气 represents the sound. The 米 (rice) component was added because this character was often used as a variant of 餼 (gift of grain).
饋客芻米也。从米气聲。《春秋傳》曰：“齊人來氣諸矦。”

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *kʰɯds, *qʰɯds): phonetic 气 (OC *kʰɯds) + semantic 米 (“rice”) – to give rice as a gift.
Later borrowed meanings of “air, flow” from 气 (OC *kʰɯds). The derivative 餼 (OC *qʰɯds) refers to the original word. Compare 乞 (OC *kʰɯds, *kʰɯd).
饋客芻米也。从米气聲。《春秋傳》曰：“齊人來氣諸矦。”
